Here’s a classic recipe‑style rundown of what you’ll need to make a hearty, traditional lasagna: | Category | Ingredient (typical amounts) | |----------|------------------------------| | **Lasagna sheets** | 9–12 sheets (no‑boil or regular – if using regular, pre‑cook them until al dente). | | **Meat sauce** | • Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork): 1 lb (≈450 g)
• Onion, finely chopped: ½ cup
• Garlic cloves, minced: 2–3
• Crushed tomatoes / tomato paste: 28 oz can + 8 oz pasta sauce (optional)
• Tomato puree or passata: 1 cup
• Red wine (optional): ¼ cup
• Olive oil: 1 tbsp
• Salt, pepper, dried oregano, basil, bay leaf(s), pinch of sugar (for acidity balance). | | **Bechamel (white béchamel)** | • Butter: 4 Tbsp (56 g)
• All‑purpose flour: ⅓ cup (40 g)
• Whole milk: 4 cups (960 ml)
• Nutmeg (freshly grated): Pinch
• Salt, white pepper: to taste | | **Ricotta mixture** | • Ricotta cheese: 15 oz (425 g)
• Egg (whole or yolk only): 1
• Grated Parmesan: ¾ cup (75 g)
• Fresh parsley or basil, chopped: 2 Tbsp
• Salt, black pepper: to taste | | **Mozzarella topping** | • Shredded mozzarella: 16 oz (450 g) (or use part mozzarella + part provolone/cheddar for extra flavor) | | **Optional extras** | • Sautéed spinach or kale (squeezed dry): 1–2 cups
- Optional “green” layer: sautéed zucchini, mushrooms, bell peppers, etc.
- Extra herbs like thyme or rosemary for depth | ### Quick Assembly Steps 1. **Cook meat sauce:** In a pan, heat olive oil → add onion & garlic → brown ground meats → stir in crushed tomatoes, wine, seasonings; simmer ~30 min. 2. **Make béchamel:** Melt butter → whisk in flour → cook 1 min → slowly pour warm milk while whisking → bring to gentle boil → reduce to thick consistency; season. 3. **Prepare ricotta blend:** Mix ricotta, egg, parmesan, herbs, salt, pepper. 4. **Layer:** Start with a thin spread of meat sauce at bottom of baking dish → alternate layers: noodles → meat sauce → béchamel → ricotta mixture → repeat → finish with topmost layer of noodles topped with remaining béchamel and shredded mozzarella. 5. **Bake:** Cover with foil (tent it so foil doesn’t touch cheese) → bake at 375°F (190°C) for 25 min → remove foil → bake another 10–15 min till bubbly & golden. Let rest 10 min before slicing. Enjoy your homemade lasagna! If you'd like variations—like vegetarian, gluten‑free, or different cheeses—just let me know.
